question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes the rules for the thirteen-storey structure?
premises: The colophon identifies the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
The subject is the rule for the thirteen-storey structure.
inference: The thirty-ninth chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa, on the rule for the thirteen-storey structure, concludes here.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, on the rule for the thirteen-storeyed structure, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
